release_scope: distribution, public interfaces, deterministic executors, and cross-agent packaging

local_client_smoke: Codex plugin validator passed with codex-cli 0.147.0
Claude plugin validate --strict passed with Claude Code 2.1.169

tagging_policy: Push v1.0.0 only after the same commit passes the complete branch CI matrix. The tag workflow reruns the offline release gate before creating the GitHub Release.
claim_boundary: Stable distribution means the package layout, public contracts, deterministic scripts, and supported installation manifests passed the declared release gates.
It does not mean that every scientific answer produced with a skill is correct, nor does it replace domain-expert review.
The protocol-v3 capability score remains withheld until all twenty skills complete L2-L4 and an independently administered frozen holdout with registered verification evidence.
